Improving Ways of Working

How do I choose the right digital solution?

Short Answer

Define the problem and user needs first, then compare approved options for fit, accessibility, security, privacy and ongoing support.

Detailed Guidance

Describe the problem and user needs without assuming a particular technology is the answer. Compare approved options against accessibility, security, privacy, integration, cost, support and sustainability requirements, then test the best fit with users before committing.
